title: The Dark Truth About Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III shows exactly where that breaks. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III is a 2017 real-time strategy game with multiplayer online battle arena influences, developed by Relic Entertainment and published by Sega. It is the third mainline entry in the Dawn of War series, and the first new release in the series since Dawn of War II: Retribution in 2011.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. In addition, a four part comic series began serialization by Titan Comics on April 19, 2017. A sequel titled Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV developed by King Art Games and published by Deep Silver, is set to be released in 2026.
